overview.pattern: Single-process-per-wallet, multi-chain, event-driven trading bot with embedded API and dashboard
overview.description: src/main.ts takes the wallet lock, then src/bot.ts startMultiChainBot runs preflight, builds per-chain contexts (src/chainRegistry.ts), listens for new DEX V2 pairs, V3 pools and Telegram alpha calls, runs safety checks, buys, and manages exits and anti-rug monitoring. Express and WebSocket (src/api/server.ts) serve the React dashboard (dashboard/).

entry-point.flow: npm start -> ts-node src/main.ts -> readStartEnv -> runMain (refuse if VITEST set; derive wallet address from PRIVATE_KEY; acquireProcessLock) -> lazy require('./bot') -> startMultiChainBot()
entry-point.description: src/main.ts is the only start path. It has no static import of config, DB, notifier, logger or bot, so nothing stateful loads before the lock; refusals go to stderr with exit 1. startMultiChainBot is called without await or catch. src/bot.ts is a library module to main.ts and cannot be started directly: its first statement imports src/guards/directEntry.ts, which exits 1 before any stateful import when bot is the process entry file, and a require.main === module block at the end of src/bot.ts also refuses. Importing src/bot.ts from elsewhere is allowed (scripts/deliberate-buy.ts does).

data-flow.flow: DEX factory events / Telegram (src/telegramListener.ts -> src/alphaDrop.ts) -> handleNewPairForChain (src/bot.ts) -> tokenSafety + honeypot simulation -> riskManager.canSnipe -> txManager/MEV strategy buy -> db.insertTrade -> exitEngine + anti-rug detector -> sell
data-flow.description: State persisted in SQLite (src/utils/db.ts); alerts via src/utils/notifier.ts and WS broadcast.

component:ProcessLock.responsibility: One bot process per wallet: SQLite exclusive file lock in a per-user folder (defaultLockDir), released by the OS on process death, pinned on globalThis so GC cannot close it. Fails closed with PROCESS_LOCK_HELD or PROCESS_LOCK_MECHANISM; no env var or flag skips it. Only src/main.ts acquires it; preflight, pause, resume, deliberate-buy and recover-sell scripts do not.

component:SingletonGuard.responsibility: Throws SINGLETON_DUPLICATE when a stateful module loads twice in one process (path-casing or link alias, query re-import). Registered by src/utils/nonceAuthority.ts, src/utils/exitManager.ts, src/exitEngine.ts, src/anti-rug/detector.ts. A full module-graph reset (new EPOCH) is allowed.

component:Database.responsibility: db.ts holds the handle and queries. dbPath.ts resolves the path against the repo root (findRepoRoot) and openGuardedDb refuses a missing, empty, uninitialised, replaced or newer-schema file. dbSchema.ts owns migrateSchema and CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION. The database is created only by npm run db:init, never at boot.

component:ChainRegistry.responsibility: Per-chain context (providers, DEX V2/V3 allowlists, config)

component:SafetyPipeline.responsibility: Honeypot roundtrip simulation, external providers (GoPlus, honeypot.is, Mudra, Unicrypt), blocklist, LP lock and limits checks

component:RiskManager.responsibility: Exposure, position count and daily loss gating (canSnipe)

component:MevSubmission.responsibility: Private submission (Flashbots, bloXroute, passthrough) with inclusion reconciliation; per-wallet nonce serialization via withNonceLock

component:ExitEngine.responsibility: Stop-loss, take-profit tiers, trailing and timed sells; per-token sell locks; serialized exit state

component:AntiRug.responsibility: LP burn and removal detection, LP baseline, exit trigger, per-chain circuit breaker, race telemetry

component:API.responsibility: Express 5 routes with session auth, helmet, WS on /ws; serves dashboard/dist. Binds DASHBOARD_HOST:DASHBOARD_PORT, default 127.0.0.1:8080

component:Preflight.responsibility: Cold-start checks (RPC chainId and block age, balances, gas affordability, MEV health, checker bytecode). preflight() runs inside startMultiChainBot; npm run preflight is the read-only operator path

security.auth: Session cookies via src/api/middleware/auth.ts protect /api/* except /api/auth; /ws validates the same session on upgrade; /health is public
security.keys: Wallet from env via src/utils/provider.ts getWallet; src/main.ts derives only the address for the lock and uses fixed error text so a rejected key is never echoed

testing.framework: Vitest unit, integration and fork projects (vitest.config.ts); Hardhat for contracts (hardhat.config.ts)
testing.rails: test/rails/ setup files plus src-layer tripwires: VITEST selects a temp DB and refuses the live data folder (src/utils/dbPath.ts), skips .env (src/config.ts) and refuses Telegram sends (src/utils/notifier.ts). src/main.ts refuses to start with VITEST set
testing.ci: .github/workflows/test.yml: unit, integration, vi.mock specifier gate, .todo ban, tsc on three tsconfigs; Hardhat, Slither and Mythril gates on contracts/** changes

conventions.file-organization: src/ top-level domain modules, src/guards/ load-time guards, src/utils/ infrastructure, src/anti-rug/ and src/api/ subsystems
conventions.imports: Relative TS imports, CommonJS output via tsc. Import order in src/bot.ts is load-bearing: guards/directEntry must stay first. require.main guards must be re-checked under any ESM conversion
